last_proven_runtime.renderer_bbox_status: diagnostic 64x64 fallback proved the missing contract; production renderer must provide real raster bounds
last_proven_runtime.note: The opening replay returned to SEQ_TITLE through SPM's own sequence/event logic, title input was accepted through the PC-native input seam, and SEQ_LOAD remained stable for 600 additional retraces. Dispatcher counts and diagnostic fast-forward are not FPS measurements.

current_target.name: first M14 Windows-native candidate
current_target.status: The strict Windows candidate, Aurora renderer, real 218-chunk player-local module, and no-fallback native execution are proven on the player PC. Bring-up has crossed syscall, DI, SI, passive IPC, host-dispatch, VI DCR, VI filter/FBWIDTH, VI display-interrupt initialization, and the physical Wii A/V-encoder path. launch(20260911-013417).log proves the A/V encoder semantic lift worked and advances to VI_DTV_STATUS at 227680 cycles. The VIGetDTVStatus-style query at 0x80282A68 is now promoted to native video-output capability service in backend dev13 and awaits runtime proof.
current_target.success_condition: a reproducible M14 Windows package boots the player-supplied R8PE01 game naturally to title, accepts real PC input, advances to file select/load, and uses renderer-owned draw completion, draw-sync, presentation, bounding-box feedback and EFB texture-copy behavior without diagnostic sequence jumps or fixed bounding-box fallbacks

current_windows_frontier.interpretation: 0xCC00206E is VI_DTV_STATUS. Guest routine 0x80282A68 interrupt-safely samples the low status bits and returns bit 0, equivalent to a VIGetDTVStatus-style component/progressive-capable output query. The PC-native Aurora/Windows output is progressive-capable, so this is a semantic host capability query rather than a reason to emulate a Wii component cable/register.
current_windows_frontier.guard: do not fabricate a Wii component cable or broad VI device model; answer the native host capability semantically and keep unrelated raw MMIO fail-closed

product_direction.target: OpenPete-class native PC port: bring-your-own supported WBFS/disc, local static recompilation/cache, no distributed Nintendo-derived code/assets, modern game-aware renderer, true ultrawide, high-resolution output, uncapped presentation with presentation-only interpolation, and a stable semantic mod SDK
product_direction.distribution_invariant: public OpenSPM artifacts contain only OpenSPM-owned code, compatibility metadata and license-compatible third-party runtime/tooling; all game-derived code/assets stay player-local
product_direction.presentation_invariant: high refresh, interpolation, ultrawide and graphics enhancements must not silently retime simulation or write presentation-only state into gameplay-readable memory

input_probe.architecture: host controller/keyboard -> OpenSPM input service -> SPM normalized per-frame button state

proven_architecture.gamefs: player WBFS -> local extraction -> ordinary host files -> SPM memory
proven_architecture.renderer_contract: backend-neutral openspm_gx_renderer_sink bound through openspm.gx-renderer service; renderer plugin DLL receives FIFO bytes plus a bounded guest-memory resolver
proven_architecture.display_list_contract: R8PE01 GXBeginDisplayList 0x80291DC8 and GXEndDisplayList 0x80291E78 remain migration host exits; neutral GX core records FIFO bytes into bounded guest RAM and returns the SDK-style 32-byte-aligned size
proven_architecture.distribution: OpenSPM runtime/tooling only; player supplies WBFS; generated game code remains local

proven_runtime_fixes: DOL BSS is zeroed before initialized sections are copied so initialized bytes win on overlap
full Wii disc bootstrap initializes MEM1/MEM2, low memory, BI2 and FST layout before game execution
outer dispatch replenishes the generated-code loop budget instead of pinning or starving polling loops
lazy floating-point-unavailable and system-call exceptions resume through architectural SRR state while unknown exceptions fail closed
ordinary game-to-game BLs remain direct native calls while semantic host targets side-exit
same-chunk DolRecomp BL-to-goto optimization is reversed for explicitly hosted targets
saved generated-direct trees are idempotently re-hosted when the semantic target manifest grows
DolRecomp CPUState::host_call classifies host-owned PCs before ordinary guest redispatch
PC-native system settings report ready without requiring Wii SYSCONF NAND
controller initialization can complete without Wii Bluetooth transport and pressed state is a per-frame snapshot
host-driven retrace wakes SPM threads through the game's real sleep/wake scheduler path in the private proof
SPM's registered post-retrace callback runs on host-driven frame events in the private proof
synchronous and asynchronous GameFS reads feed player-owned extracted files into SPM memory and invoke guest completion callbacks
DSP/JAudio bootstrap completes the observable task-upload and task-init callback contract without guest DSP microcode execution in the private proof
GX draw-done completion is deferred until after the guest arms its finish wait, then wakes the real finish queue in the private proof
GX draw-sync BP tokens are reflected through the PE token register so sysWaitDrawSync can complete normally
GX display-list begin/end use OpenSPM-owned bounded guest-memory capture rather than diagnostic sentinels; successful list sizes are zero-padded to 32-byte alignment and overflow returns zero
fresh-PC-install save semantics preserve blank in-memory save slots and complete startup without Wii NAND plumbing
Wii cache-maintenance boundaries are hosted as coherent-PC barriers/no-ops, including same-chunk callsites
DI_CONFIG startup read, SI startup transaction state, and passive Broadway IPC bootstrap are bounded in OpenSPM-owned platform code
VI DCR reports host video enabled; VI filter coefficients, FBWIDTH, and display-interrupt configuration are guest-visible bounded state while Aurora owns scanout
physical Wii A/V encoder configuration is runtime-proven as a semantic video-output host boundary instead of GPIO/I2C emulation
VI component/progressive output detection is promoted to a native video-output capability query instead of creating a fake Wii component-cable device; runtime proof is pending
known_nonproduction_diagnostics: The headless proof supplied a fixed 64x64 GX bounding box. Zero PE bbox registers decoded as signed -2 dimensions and caused malformed 1022x1022 texture descriptors; larger synthetic boxes exhausted SPM's effect smart heap. The Windows renderer must supply actual raster bounds.
Diagnostic validation may fast-forward host retrace wall time while preserving one guest retrace/event cycle at a time. This is not an FPS benchmark.
Some timing/audio/GX-completion behavior remains proven only in the private diagnostic harness and must be reproduced by reusable OpenSPM services before persistent title parity is claimed.

renderer_work.aurora_runtime_dependency_staging: reuse pinned Aurora AuroraCopyRuntimeDLLs.cmake so SDL/Dawn/TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS and Dawn DXC DLLs are staged with runtime/openspm_renderer.dll; renderer_loader uses LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DLL_LOAD_DIR so transitive dependencies are resolved from runtime/ explicitly

renderer_work.public_candidate_audit: tools/release/audit_public_candidate.py rejects disc images, DOL/REL/WAD payloads, extracted-disc/private-cache directories and openspm_local_native.dll before CI uploads the candidate skeleton
renderer_work.raw_efb_copy_note: BP 0x49/0x4A reconstruct source extent; 0x4B resolves the shifted guest destination so later Image3 mapping shares copy-texture identity; 0x52 decodes common color/component/depth formats. Stage-A currently sizes the native copy texture to the exact EFB source extent because raw hardware exposes stride rather than Aurora's high-level destination rectangle. Validate padded/subrectangle cases on real SPM before claiming full copy parity.
aurora_raw_console_gaps_audited: CP array-base registers require host-pointer adaptation
GX_CMD_CALL_DL must resolve/call guest display-list bytes
raw texture Image3 and TLUT physical addresses require guest-memory resolution
raw EFB texture-copy source/destination and format state require reconstruction from BP registers
hardware display-copy requires native presentation semantics
GX bounding-box read/clear requires renderer-owned raster feedback
renderer_work.adaptation_rule: Use a small pinned OpenSPM-specific guest-address/presentation/bbox layer around Aurora. Do not import Dolphin/WiiCompiled GPL renderer code and do not put Wii-address knowledge into the neutral OpenSPM backend.
